findings.body: When `selection.timeWindow` is absent, `lastMonthBudgetPin` always returns `undefined`; if the result is budget-only, there are also no Actual pins, so `predicateRange` is null and the name resolver receives neither rows nor the available latest budget batch. The supported all-data Ask path therefore renders bare GL codes even when `activeBatchIds` contains a budget batch whose outline supplies the required fallback label. Derive the effective last pinned month from provenance when the selection has no explicit window and still pass false/empty-Actual predicates for budget-only rows.
findings.title: Not done: Budget-only all-data answers use the pinned MIS label

findings.body: The test case named `no Actual grant` is identical to the preceding Budget-only case: both select only `governed-financial.budget` and grant only Budget. Consequently it cannot fail if the user-permission check in `issueAskDrill` is removed; absence of drill metadata is already forced by the selection not containing Actual. The required distinct leaf must exercise an Actual-bearing selection with a reader lacking the Actual grant and prove that neither an Actual value nor drill metadata is returned.
findings.title: Not done: Prove the reader-without-Actual-grant case

findings.body: The test named as a `POST` test directly invokes `controller.run`, bypassing Nest routing, guards, body parsing, exception handling, and persistence through the real audit service. It therefore does not satisfy the required real-entry-point proof that a context-less HTTP request reaches the service, writes a refusal audit record, returns 403, and performs no transaction read. Add an HTTP-level test through the initialized application and real audit boundary.
findings.title: Not done: Exercise the missing-context refusal through the POST route

findings.body: The newly added size-limit rule says an oversized row carries no amount, but the unchanged generic context description at lines 82–84 still requires an exact-paise Actual “for every row,” and C5a at lines 223–224 repeats that each row carries one. These mutually exclusive requirements leave the confirmed contract ambiguous despite the implementation's discriminated union. Explicitly exempt the C5d inert variant in both generic descriptions.
findings.title: Keep oversized context rows consistent in the confirmed spec

findings.body: The task table explicitly defers rendering `drillable` Actuals as buttons and proving inert cells make no request to GL-DRILL-PANEL. The current `frontend/src/features/assistant/ask-panel.tsx` consumes `rowLabels` but not `AskResponse.drill`, so this branch alone does not complete Done-when item 6's user-visible interaction. Per the task assignment, this remains a P2 later-task gap rather than a blocker for the backend wiring implementation.
findings.title: Later: GL-DRILL-PANEL must consume the signed drill metadata
